payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is at least one frog visibly placed within the toilet bowl opening, rather than only on the lid, seat, or floor?
node.criteria: complete: at least one frog is visibly within the toilet bowl opening. partial: a frog is present on or near the toilet but none is clearly within the bowl opening, or placement there is ambiguous. absent: no frog has been added to the scene. unknown: image evidence is insufficient to determine whether a frog is within the bowl opening.
node.binding: The requested frog placement relative to the visible toilet bowl opening.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image shows a frog clearly inside the toilet bowl opening; additional frogs appear on the lid and floor.","confidence":0.99}

parsed.evidence: The edited image shows a frog clearly inside the toilet bowl opening; additional frogs appear on the lid and floor.
